sentences.en: Julie Davis, where should we begin?
sentences.zh: 朱莉·戴维斯，我们从哪里开始说起呢？

sentences.en: So last Wednesday, there was this meeting.
sentences.zh: 上周三，举行了一次会议。

sentences.en: It's the weekly gathering of the House Democratic
sentences.zh: 这是众议院民主党

sentences.en: Caucus.
sentences.zh: 党团会议的每周例会。

sentences.en: They're there to talk about their legislative agenda, any issues that they need to address as a party, what's going on that week.
sentences.zh: 他们聚在一起讨论立法议程、作为政党需要解决的问题，以及当周发生的事务。

sentences.en: And it's a closed-door meeting.
sentences.zh: 这是一次闭门会议。

sentences.en: No press is allowed inside.
sentences.zh: 不允许媒体进入。

sentences.en: But because it was such a remarkable kind of monologue from Nancy Pelosi, a number of sources who were in the room filled me in on what she said.
sentences.zh: 但由于南希·佩洛西发表了一番非常引人注目的独白，几位在场的消息人士向我透露了她所说的话。

sentences.en: And what does she say?
sentences.zh: 她说了什么？

sentences.en: So she basically starts to say things like, some of you are here to make a beautiful pate, but we're making sausage most of the time.
sentences.zh: 她基本上是这样说的：你们有些人来这里是为了做精美的肉酱，但我们大多数时候是在做香肠。

sentences.en: You know, the process can be ugly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，过程可能会很丑陋。

sentences.en: We don't always get what we want out of it.
sentences.zh: 我们并不总能从中得到我们想要的。

sentences.en: But, you know, we can't have our ideal perfect outcome all the time.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我们不可能总是得到理想的完美结果。

sentences.en: And what she's focused on, what she says House Democrats need to be focused on, is coming out with the best version of what they can get, given that they have just one chamber,
sentences.zh: 她所关注的，以及她认为众议院民主党人需要关注的，是在他们只有一个议院的情况下，拿出他们能达到的最佳版本，

sentences.en: the House and the Senate is controlled by Republicans, and the president is a Republican and obviously wants very different things.
sentences.zh: 众议院由民主党控制，而参议院由共和党控制，总统也是共和党人，显然他们想要的东西非常不同。

sentences.en: She says, don't play into their hands.
sentences.zh: 她说，不要落入他们的圈套。

sentences.en: Every day, some of our members have to fight the fight for their re-election.
sentences.zh: 每一天，我们的一些成员都必须为他们的连任而战。

sentences.en: It's easy for me and my district.
sentences.zh: 在我的选区，这很容易。

sentences.en: But then she goes on to say, there are some members who are not in that situation.
sentences.zh: 但她接着说，有些成员并不处于那种境地。

sentences.en: These members, some of these moderate members, actually are the reason that we are in the majority.
sentences.zh: 这些成员，其中一些温和派成员，实际上是我们能够占据多数席位的原因。

sentences.en: And so all of the representatives, even if they come from safe Democratic districts, need to be thinking about them.
sentences.zh: 所以所有的代表，即使他们来自稳固的民主党选区，也需要为他们着想。

sentences.en: What is she saying there?
sentences.zh: 她那番话是什么意思？

sentences.en: She's essentially saying it's great to be ideologically pure.
sentences.zh: 她本质上是在说，在意识形态上保持纯洁固然很好。

sentences.en: It's great to have the energy of the progressive base.
sentences.zh: 拥有进步派基层的活力固然很好。

sentences.en: But if you're not going to do things that are going to advance legislation that we can actually kind of deliver on, then it can be detrimental.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不做那些能推进我们实际上可以交付的立法的事情，那么这可能会是有害的。

sentences.en: And she ends her comments with a pretty sharp warning to her members to essentially keep these fights in the family.
sentences.zh: 她以对成员们相当严厉的警告结束了她的评论，本质上是让他们把这些争吵留在内部解决。

sentences.en: If they have a problem, she says they should come to her.
sentences.zh: 她说，如果他们有问题，应该来找她。

sentences.en: She says, you got a complaint?
sentences.zh: 她说，你有抱怨吗？

sentences.en: You come and talk to me.
sentences.zh: 你来找我谈。

sentences.en: Julie, why is the speaker giving this lecture at this moment?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，为什么议长要在此时发表这番训话？

sentences.en: What is she up to?
sentences.zh: 她想干什么？

sentences.en: Well, she's really talking to four members in particular, freshman members of Congress,
sentences.zh: 嗯，她实际上是在对四位成员特别喊话，她们是国会的新人议员，

sentences.en: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez from New York, Ilhan Omar from Minnesota, Rashida Tlaib of Michigan, and Ayanna Pressley of Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 来自纽约的亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯、来自明尼苏达州的伊尔汗·奥马尔、来自密歇根州的拉希达·特莱布，以及来自马萨诸塞州的阿亚娜·普雷斯利。

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: and between really the broader Democratic caucus in this group now for many, many days.

sentences.zh: 它们是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: Well, they start in many ways right after the midterm congressional elections.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在很多方面，它们始于中期国会选举之后。

sentences.en: When, you know, you had this new crop of women coming in who had a very strong kind of progressive bent,
sentences.zh: 当时，你知道，有一批新的女性议员进入国会，她们有着非常强烈的进步倾向，

sentences.en: they made it very clear they really wanted to dramatically change the direction of the institution, change the face of the Democratic caucus.
sentences.zh: 她们非常明确地表示，她们真的想彻底改变该机构的方向，改变民主党党团的面貌。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: I just want to let you all know how proud I am of each and every single one of you.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让你们所有人知道，我对你们每一个人感到多么自豪。

sentences.en: Before the new Congress even convenes, right after the midterm congressional elections, some climate protesters stage a sit-in outside of Nancy Pelosi's office.
sentences.zh: 在新一届国会召开之前，就在中期国会选举后，一些气候抗议者在南希·佩洛西的办公室外举行了静坐示威。

sentences.en: We have to get to 100% renewable energy in 10 years.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在10年内实现100%的可再生能源。

sentences.en: There is no other option.
sentences.zh: 没有其他选择。

sentences.en: And who joins them but the newly elected Congresswoman from New York,
sentences.zh: 谁加入了她们呢？正是新当选的纽约州女国会议员，

sentences.en: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, protesting her soon-to-be speaker.

sentences.zh: 如果佩洛西领袖成为下一任众议院议长，我们需要告诉她，我们支持她展示和追求这个国家有史以来见过的最进步的能源

sentences.en: agenda that this country has ever seen.

sentences.zh: 就在这一刻，你可以看出，你知道，她来到国会山确实是以一个带着议程的活动家身份，以一种不同于

sentences.en: is not your typical member of Congress.

sentences.zh: 但这随后也开始在数周和数月内上演。

sentences.zh: 亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯和“小分队”都投票支持南希·佩洛西担任议长。

sentences.en: And, you know, they all have some pretty good committee assignments.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她们都得到了一些相当不错的委员会职位。

sentences.en: Thanks to Nancy Pelosi, they're able to have a seat at the table.
sentences.zh: 多亏了南希·佩洛西，她们得以在谈判桌上占有一席之地。

sentences.en: But rather than simply acting like most freshmen members of Congress do, where they maybe introduce some legislation here and there and sort of keep their mouths mostly shut.
sentences.zh: 但她们并没有像大多数国会新生议员那样行事，即偶尔提出一些立法，然后基本上保持沉默。

sentences.en: I am so excited.
sentences.zh: 我太兴奋了。

sentences.en: They're very active and sort of demanding action on various legislation that they think is not getting enough attention.
sentences.zh: 她们非常活跃，要求对她们认为没有得到足够关注的各种立法采取行动。

sentences.en: Because we're going to go in there, we're going to impeach the motherfucker.
sentences.zh: 因为我们要进去，我们要弹劾那个混蛋。

sentences.en: And they start to make that very clear.
sentences.zh: 她们开始非常明确地表达这一点。

sentences.en: Using Twitter and using the activist community that they're very close to, to sort of really
sentences.zh: 利用推特和她们关系非常密切的活动家社区，来真正

sentences.en: start to criticize Pelosi and some of their Democratic colleagues for essentially sort of tiptoeing around what they think should be much bolder policies.

sentences.en: Pushing things like the Green New Deal, things like Medicare for all, some of these multi-trillion dollar progressive agenda items that are very sort of popular with the base.

sentences.en: And you see a lot of the
sentences.zh: 你会看到很多

sentences.en: But realistically, they don't have much chance of getting off of Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 但现实地说，这些议程在国会山通过的机会并不大。

sentences.en: And for the first several months that the House Democrats are in control, Pelosi keeps a pretty tight rein on it.
sentences.zh: 在众议院民主党人掌权的最初几个月里，佩洛西一直保持着相当严格的控制。

sentences.en: And it all seemed to be working out pretty well until a couple of weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 一切似乎都进展得相当顺利，直到几周前。

sentences.zh: 那后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: We have gotten our clearest picture yet of the growing crisis at the southern border.
sentences.zh: 我们已经得到了关于南部边境日益严重的危机的最清晰的画面。

sentences.en: So a couple of weeks ago, there were all these reports of the horrible overcrowding in facilities holding migrants at the border.
sentences.zh: 几周前，有各种关于边境移民拘留设施中可怕的过度拥挤的报道。

sentences.en: The report shows migrants held in standing room only cells for a week at a time, while others confined for more than a month in overcrowded
sentences.zh: 报告显示，移民们被关在只能站立的牢房里，一次长达一周，而其他人则在过度拥挤的房间里被关押了一个多月。

sentences.en: rooMs. Terrible pictures of subhuman conditions in these places.
sentences.zh: 这些地方存在非人道状况的糟糕照片。

sentences.en: We're now hearing from a lawyer who visited one center in Texas and a doctor visiting another describing it as, quote, torture.
sentences.zh: 我们现在从一位访问过德克萨斯州一个中心的一位律师和一位访问另一个中心的医生那里听说，他们将其描述为，引用原话，“酷刑”。

sentences.en: And the administration had been asking for some humanitarian aid funding.
sentences.zh: 政府一直在寻求一些人道主义援助资金。

sentences.en: And there was an effort to bring a bill to the floor of both the House and the Senate to sort of deal with this.
sentences.zh: 有人努力将一项法案提交到众议院和参议院进行表决，以处理这个问题。

sentences.en: They needed to pass some emergency money and just get it to the border quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们需要通过一些紧急资金，并尽快将其送到边境。

sentences.en: So kind of standard, fund the agencies, fund the facilities, as Pelosi might say, kind of sausage, not pate.
sentences.zh: 所以这很标准，资助机构，资助设施，正如佩洛西可能说的，这就像做香肠，而不是做肉酱。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And, you know, they had it was going to be a strictly humanitarian bill.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们当时……这本来是一项纯粹的人道主义法案。

sentences.en: They had already talked about the fact that there wasn't going to be any wall money, no enforcement money.
sentences.zh: 他们已经讨论过这样一个事实，即不会有任何修墙资金，也不会有执法资金。

sentences.en: This was really just supposed to address the humanitarian crisis.
sentences.zh: 这本来只是为了解决人道主义危机。

sentences.en: And for some members, including the squad, this was seen as sort of a perfect opportunity to really protest the entirety of President
sentences.zh: 对于一些成员，包括“小分队”来说，这被视为一个完美的契机，可以真正抗议特朗普总统的整个移民议程。

sentences.en: Trump's immigration agenda.
sentences.zh: 而且因为它是一项必须通过的法案，因为它在某种程度上被视为例行公事，在她们看来，这是表达她们

sentences.zh: 对整个移民议程的反感和不满的完美载体。

sentences.en: antipathy, their discontent with the entire immigration agenda.
sentences.zh: 最终，佩洛西以压倒性多数通过了该法案。

sentences.en: And in the end, Pelosi is able to pass it with an overwhelming majority.
sentences.zh: 除了“小分队”之外，所有的众议院民主党人，包括所有的进步派，都投了赞成票。

sentences.en: All of the House Democrats, including all of the progressives, vote for it, except for the squad.
sentences.zh: 那么，这张反对该法案的选票对于“小分队”和佩洛西之间酝酿的冲突意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, it just brings them all to the fore, because what ends up happening is that the

sentences.zh: 我们甚至没有费心去谈判。

sentences.en: to accept a much weaker bill that the squad hates even more, and that many Democrats hate even more.

sentences.en: And that's where the finger-pointing starts.

sentences.en: We didn't even bother to negotiate.

sentences.en: I will not support anything that is broken and that dehumanizes people, but guess what?
sentences.zh: 她们正在发表关于南希·佩洛西以及她如何处理这一过程的声明。

sentences.en: Mitch McConnell sent you back something that was worse.
sentences.zh: 我认为在民主党内部，我们经常忙于试图安抚每个人，结果却谁也没安抚好。

sentences.en: They're making statements about Nancy Pelosi and how she's mishandled the process.

sentences.en: And so when they're loud about the policies that they think need attention, the moderates and the party as a whole get branded as something that it's not.
